gen-gf-raleway-dots-fs-rowan: Raleway Dots pairs heavy, inky stems with filament-thin hairlines, a sharp split that makes a splashy impression. But Rowan, with open curves and tilted-nib stems, is the one to settle into for a modest helping of text.
gen-gf-raleway-dots-lora: Raleway Dots is all heavy shoulders and hairline joins. Lora, with a broad, welcoming c, brings bookish stems barely heavier than their arms, though it won't carry page after page.
gen-gf-rampart-one-fs-rowan: Expressive and shuttered, Rampart One stays closed and snug in the lowercase where Rowan opens every curve wide. Rampart One earns its keep when it's big and brief.
gen-gf-ranga-fs-rowan: A dark, tightly knit stripe of text: that's Ranga. Its unshaded outline does the loud work up top, while the serif Rowan, moderate in contrast, handles a few quick lines with friendly, open curves.
gen-gf-red-rose-fs-karma: Commanding and distinctive, Red Rose fills the middle of the line with a tall x-height and an open e. But Karma, with a mild, wire-like taper, handles the steadier, classic work of body text.
gen-gf-red-rose-fs-paquito: Paquito, a confident serif with barely any gap between lowercase and caps, feels approachable beside Red Rose. And Red Rose brings the commanding punch, an open e and a middle-filling x-height, though endless paragraphs aren't its job.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-bespoke-sans: Casual, hand-drawn charm with a tight letterfit: that's Schoolbell. Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, with generous space at its curve ends, and it's pleasant in modest helpings rather than long stretches.
gen-gf-schoolbell-fs-neco: Neco reads authoritative and dignified, never pinching a curve shut. Schoolbell brings monoline, casual handwriting up front, and Neco follows with a smooth, modest swell, built for brief visits rather than marathons.
gen-gf-schoolbell-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans reads modern and precise, with curve endings kept apart. Page after page its monoline strokes stay crisp rather than cozy, though it prefers brief spells beside the casual, hand-drawn Schoolbell.
gen-gf-shadows-into-light-two-fs-literat: Loose, friendly handwriting with outward-opening curves: that's Shadows Into Light Two. Literata grounds it with sturdy thin lines and bookish, wide-mouthed curves, a sophisticated partner that is comfortable in brief helpings.
